decision.reason: [ev-2e8e5d370444] is only a changelog line containing the title of a design-proposal PR ("Proposal: Crossplane v2") and a link to PR #6255. It doesn't name a field, API, component or behaviour, so the subject, change, applicability and consequence can't be determined. Deciding them would need the PR content or the design document it adds, and that may turn out to be a design proposal with no runtime effect.
